title: Macro-conscious entities keep their nested subsidiary conscious entities

statements.text: Any biological macro-conscious entity has nested micro- and macro-conscious entities. Following Whitehead’s principle that the many become one and are increased by one, the subsidiary entities are not extinguished, against the exclusion principle of integrated information theory, and processes subconscious to the dominant consciousness are conscious for themselves.

sources.quote: principle that the many become one and are increased by one
we view these lower-level entities as conscious for themselves
